visualCharacteristics.purpose: Vollflächige Bühne mit Hintergrundvideo, H1, Preis, CTAs und Verbrauchsangaben
visualCharacteristics.layout: full-viewport stage, content bottom-left over gradient
visualCharacteristics.media: autoplay muted loop playsinline video; poster image as fallback and for prefers-reduced-motion

contentPattern.structure: row 1: video link (MP4 in DAM, e.g. /content/dam/audidemo/<file>.mp4); row 2: poster image (with alt); row 3: H1 title, price paragraph, CTA links; row 4: consumption/emission disclaimer (rich text)

reuseGuidance: Use for a page stage with a background video; for a still-image stage use hero.
